title: I'm working on a Pinball RPG / Creature Collector
author: Galethorne
selftext:
I'm using Opus 5.5 for this game. The way I'm doing it right now is that I make terrible drawings of the tables and ask Claude to turn it into a reality. It's vibe-coded but I put a lot of work into making sure every table actually works and looks the way I want it to. Right now it still has a lot of AI-created placeholder text like the monster names and their descriptions but I want to replace all text lines in the game for the full release.

It already has 15 tables and is like 50% done. Basically, you fight and catch monsters, you let them fight for you and your marble level grows as well so you become more powerful. Every pinball cabinet represents a level within the RPG campaign, so beating one table grants access to the next one.

If you want to try it out, you can do that [here](https://galethorne.itch.io/flipper-fantasy)
